F.label: F01.1
F.text: To make autopilot flight targets settable by the pilot (commit numeric altitude/heading/speed setpoints).

F.label: F02.1
F.text: To make the pilot aware that the autopilot has reached the commanded target.

F.label: F03.1
F.text: Engage an autopilot mode: transition the aircraft from manual to autopilot-controlled flight by committing it to a selected automation behaviour, with a defined autopilot mode becoming active.

F.label: F04.1
F.text: To terminate an active autopilot mode.

F.label: F04.2
F.text: To enable pilot selection of manual flight control.

F.label: F05.1
F.text: Submit structured intelligence reports to C2.

F.label: F06.1
F.text: Convey the order's content to the pilot (comprehension of what is tasked): the pilot understands what the order is — type, target/area, parameters — not just that one arrived, via a sustained readable/legible presentation the pilot can parse and reference.

F.label: F07.2
F.text: Pilot reports a surveillance event with its classification to C2.

F.label: F08.1
F.text: Deliver a discrete transactional message (acknowledgement/confirmation); transient and command-tied, making the pilot aware that a commanded action completed or was accepted.

F.label: F08.2
F.text: Present a persistent incoming message requiring pilot cognizance (e.g. C2 order or UAV-pilot response); retained and retrievable until acknowledged, carrying mission information the pilot acts on.

F.label: F08.3
F.text: Signal a capability/state change (e.g. data-link lost, autopilot condition reached) that alters what the pilot can do, making the pilot aware of the changed operating envelope.

F.label: F09.1
F.text: Pilot issues a takeover request for a selected UAV.

F.label: F10.1
F.text: Execute the takeover command (commit to assume control): give the pilot a means to command the takeover procedure once acknowledgment is received, turning a granted request into an active control transfer (UC 4.2.2-4.2.3).

F.label: F11.1
F.text: Pilot submits new UAV flight parameters (speed/altitude/heading) so the pilot's chosen values become the UAV's commanded targets.

F.label: F11.2
F.text: Pilot is made aware the UAV accepted the new parameters, providing closure on the round-trip acknowledgment.

F.label: F12.1
F.text: Pilot can call up (show) and dismiss (hide) the status panel of any connected UAV.

F.label: F13.1
F.text: Maintain continuous UAV status awareness.

F.label: F13.2
F.text: Alert the pilot to UAV status changes/anomalies.

F.label: F14.1
F.text: Command sensor line-of-sight to a designated target/point/area.

F.label: F15.1
F.text: Specify search-pattern geometry over a geographic area: the pilot delimits where coverage happens by defining the area/track shape (e.g. lawnmower box, spiral, sector, polygon) anchored on the map.

F.label: F15.2
F.text: Parameterize a search pattern's scan attributes: the pilot sets how the pattern is flown/scanned — leg spacing, orientation/heading, scan speed, overlap.

F.label: F16.1
F.text: Summon ISR sensor feed into view

F.label: F16.2
F.text: Select which ISR data stream to expose

F.label: F17.1
F.text: Designate the TOI: establish which target the UAV should track via spatial/identity selection (shared designation goal, reuses R14's target-selection surface).

F.label: F17.2
F.text: Command the UAV to track the designated TOI: commit the tracking order, directing UAV sensors to lock/center on the specified target.

F.label: F18.1
F.text: Set the standoff distance value: the pilot establishes/adjusts the numeric distance the UAV maintains from the TOI, committing a scalar range parameter.

F.label: F19.1
F.text: Dispatch a control-handover request to a selected UAV.

F.label: F20.1
F.text: Command handover execution (confirmation-gated one-shot commit); mirrors R10 command takeover. Pilot issues the handover-execute command, offered/armed only once the R19 handover request is acknowledged. Completion awareness (8.1.17-8.1.18) and status-hide (8.1.16) are handled by reuse of R08 notifications and R12/R13 status panel rather than new Functions.

Be.label: Be01.1.1
Be.text: Direct value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be01.1.2
Be.text: Increment/step value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be01.1.3
Be.text: Preset pick value entry via WAD field (Touch keypad / Keyboard UCP or rotary).

Be.label: Be02.1.1
Be.text: Discrete event announcement. Screen shows Target field + real-time Current field, awareness via convergence. Audio-out gives a one-shot callout at transition.

Be.label: Be03.1.1
Be.text: Direct mode selection (flat, one-shot): each autopilot mode is individually addressable and committing to one is the engagement. Touch: tap the target mode on the WAD Autopilot Mode Panel. Keyboard: a dedicated bezel OSS per mode, or rotary-step to a mode plus a commit button. One deliberate actuation engages the selected mode; full task completable via Touch alone, Keyboard alone, or any mix.

Be.label: Be04.1.1
Be.text: Deactivate-by-re-press: the pilot re-presses the currently-active autopilot mode control to deselect it; the HMI forwards the manual-control command and the mode indicator clears on aircraft confirmation. Realized via Touch alone (re-tap active mode on WAD), Keyboard alone (re-press active-mode OSS), or mixed. Realizes F-04.1 (terminate an active autopilot mode).

Be.label: Be04.2.1
Be.text: One-shot disengage: the pilot issues a single discrete action on a dedicated MANUAL affordance to hand control back to manual flight. Realized via Touch alone (tap MANUAL button), Keyboard alone (press MANUAL OSS), or mixed. Realizes F-04.2 (enable pilot selection of manual flight control).

Be.label: Be05.1.1
Be.text: Press-and-hold on Map screen opens an option ring at that location; pilot selects a preset intelligence marker from the ring; selection commits the marker at that map location and sends it to C2. Touch alone (hold on WAD + tap) / Keyboard alone (bezel rotary step + OSS confirm) / mixed.

Be.label: Be06.1.1
Be.text: Full parallel presentation**: on order arrival, complete order content rendered persistently on Screen AND spoken in full via templated TTS; either channel alone conveys the complete order.

Be.label: Be07.2.1
Be.text: Classify-then-commit, map-anchored (R05 pattern extended): press-and-hold on Map at the observed location -> option ring appears -> select event-type marker from ring -> report auto-populates with type + location -> commit/send. Keyboard path: bezel OSS to open report, UCP/rotary to step through event types, OSS to commit. Modality-complete (Touch / Keyboard).

Be.label: Be08.1.3
Be.text: Transactional acknowledgement delivered via combined Screen+Audio: an attention audio callout plays synchronized with a minimalist transient pop-up on the WAD that auto-decays after ~5 seconds; conveys a short command-confirmed message with no pilot dismissal required.

Be.label: Be08.2.3
Be.text: Persistent incoming message (C2 order / UAV-pilot response) delivered via combined Screen+Audio: a distinct new-message audio cue on arrival, a preview pop-up showing the first words, and a notification marker on a persistent Messages tab/list that retains the message until acknowledged, with the full message retrievable by selecting the marker.

Be.label: Be08.3.3
Be.text: Capability/state-change message delivered via combined Screen+Audio: a distinct state-change audio signature at the moment of transition and a directed notification marker anchored to the screen/panel that changed; selecting the marker opens an on-demand pop-up detailing what changed, while the new steady state is held visually.

Be.label: Be09.1.1
Be.text: Select-then-request (two-step, explicit): pilot selects the target UAV from a roster/map, then triggers a distinct REQUEST TAKEOVER action. Two deliberate acts. Feedback: request-pending state shown (ties into R08 notification pattern for the eventual UAV-Pilot response). Modality-complete: Touch (tap UAV glyph then tap REQUEST button) or Keyboard (bezel OSS steps/selects UAV then OSS commits request); UCP could enter UAV ID directly.

Be.label: Be09.1.2
Be.text: Direct action-on-object (one gesture carries selection + intent): pilot press-and-holds the UAV target (map glyph or roster row), option ring appears, selects Takeover, commits. Single continuous flow, selection and request fused. Reuses R05/R07 map-anchored press-hold to option-ring to commit grammar. Keyboard equivalent: OSS to focus UAV, OSS to open action menu, step to Takeover, commit.

Be.label: Be09.1.3
Be.text: Request from a UAV-detail context: pilot opens the selected UAV's detail/status panel first, then issues takeover from within that context (button in the panel). Selection is implicit (whatever UAV panel is open). Fewer stray-target risks, but requires the panel to already be the working context.

Be.label: Be10.1.1
Be.text: Single deliberate one-shot commit, state-gated on takeover-request confirmation. The COMMAND TAKEOVER affordance is inert/disabled until the R09 request acknowledgment (delivered via R08) is received. Once confirmed, a single action (Touch tap or bezel OSS press) transmits the takeover command (4.2.2-4.2.3). No separate confirm step - the prior acknowledgment is the gate. Modality-complete: Touch tap on WAD affordance OR bezel OSS press, each completes the full commit alone.

Be.label: Be11.1.1
Be.text: Direct value entry (primary): pilot opens the UAV parameter panel and enters speed/altitude/heading values directly via numeric keypad (Touch) or UCP/bezel alphanumeric (Keyboard), then commits. Mirrors Be-01.1 AP setpoint direct entry; modality-complete on either path.

Be.label: Be11.1.2
Be.text: Step/increment adjustment (complement): pilot nudges each parameter up/down via on-screen steppers (Touch) or bezel rotary (Keyboard), suited to small corrections under vibration. Mirrors Be-01.2.

Be.label: Be11.1.3
Be.text: Preset parameter profiles: pilot selects a stored profile (e.g. loiter, transit) that populates all three values at once, then commits. Mirrors Be-01.3 preset logic.

Be.label: Be11.2.1
Be.text: Redundant acknowledgment notification: on UAV acceptance of new parameters, fire the shared R08 audio tone plus visual pop-up/marker. Output modality-complete; reuses the R08 notification pattern.

Be.label: Be12.1.1
Be.text: Toggle affordance: a persistent UAV-status control (button/tab) shows the panel with current status on tap, and hides it on re-press. Single reused affordance drives both open and close. Modality-complete: Touch tap or bezel OSS toggle; Screen renders the panel.

Be.label: Be12.1.2
Be.text: Separate show/dismiss affordances: one control opens the panel; a distinct close control (X on the panel header, or dismiss OSS) hides it. Explicit two-action model coexisting with the toggle for unambiguous dismissal.

Be.label: Be13.1.1
Be.text: Persistent multi-field status render: UAV status fields (link, mode, health, fuel, position/attitude summary) continuously displayed on Screen in a fixed panel, updating in place as new data arrives; no audio in steady state.

Be.label: Be13.2.1
Be.text: Redundant alert on transition: on a status change or fault, fire a one-shot audio tone plus a visual highlight/flag on the changed status field; modality-complete across Screen and Audio-out.

Be.label: Be13.2.2
Be.text: Severity-graded alert: same transition-triggered alerting as Be13.2.1 but with tone and visual treatment differentiated by severity tier (advisory/caution/warning), e.g. link-loss as warning, mode change as advisory.

Be.label: Be14.1.1
Be.text: Touch, discrete: press-and-hold on Map/feed location, option ring appears, select 'Move Sensor Here' (POI/AOI variant), commit slew. Reuses R05/R07 press-hold to option-ring pattern.

Be.label: Be14.1.2
Be.text: HMD, discrete: gaze/head designates the aimpoint on the visor, confirm via HOTAS button or UCP keyboard press, commit slew.

Be.label: Be14.1.3
Be.text: HMD, continuous: head-slaved continuous steering, sensor aim follows head pointing while an engage condition is held, look-to-slew, release to stop.

Be.label: Be14.1.4
Be.text: Touch, continuous: rate-slew via TDC deflection (primary) or WAD swipe-drag on the feed, sensor slews proportional to input, release/center stops.

Be.label: Be15.1.1
Be.text: Touch-only: pilot direct-manipulates on the Map — tap to drop area vertices/corners (box, sector, or polygon), drag to size/rotate the shape, with live geometry preview; commit sends.

Be.label: Be15.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: pilot enters pattern geometry numerically via UCP/bezel — anchor coords, dimensions (length/width or radius), orientation — stepping through fields; map echoes each value; commit via bezel OSS.

Be.label: Be15.1.3
Be.text: Mixed: touch to place/rough-shape the area on the map, then keyboard to refine exact dimensions/coords of the same object; each pathway remains modality-complete standalone.

Be.label: Be15.2.1
Be.text: Touch-only: Setpoint-style panel (reused from R01/R11) with keypad direct entry, steppers, and presets for each scan attribute (leg spacing, orientation, scan speed, overlap); commit on panel.

Be.label: Be15.2.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: same scan attribute set entered via bezel rotary (step) plus UCP alphanumeric (direct value), field-by-field; commit via OSS.

Be.label: Be15.2.3
Be.text: Mixed: field-by-field combination on the Setpoint Panel (some fields by touch, others by keyboard); inherent to the shared Setpoint-Panel capability rather than a separate design effort.

Be.label: Be16.1.1
Be.text: Touch-only: one-shot summon/dismiss of the ISR feed via a persistent 'ISR FEED' button on the UAV screen plus a WAD panel header control (X / re-summon).

Be.label: Be16.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: dedicated bezel OSS / UCP soft-key toggles the ISR feed panel on/off with one-shot summon/dismiss semantics.

Be.label: Be16.2.1
Be.text: Touch-only: direct selection of the exposed ISR stream via an in-panel source tab strip/list (EO/IR/radar/...), tapping a source switches the active stream.

Be.label: Be16.2.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: bezel rotary (detented) or UCP up/down keys step through the available ISR sources, with the current selection reflected on the panel.

Be.label: Be17.1.1
Be.text: Touch-only: pilot taps a target symbol on the Map/ISR feed to select it; press-hold on empty space drops a TOI marker at that point (reuses R14 press-hold to option-ring designation pattern). Selected target highlights as the active TOI.

Be.label: Be17.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: pilot cycles through detected tracks/contacts with a bezel rotary (step through target list), OSS to confirm selection; or enters target coordinates/track-ID via UCP alphanumeric.

Be.label: Be17.2.1
Be.text: Touch-only: with a TOI active, pilot selects TRACK from the option-ring (or a dedicated on-screen TRACK button) as a one-shot commit that sends the tracking order.

Be.label: Be17.2.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: dedicated bezel TRACK OSS, pressed to commit tracking on the active TOI.

Be.label: Be17.2.3
Be.text: Mixed: designate via Touch (tap target), commit via Keyboard (bezel TRACK OSS); spatial designation suits touch while the discrete safety-relevant commit suits a fixed physical button. Offered as convenience, not a required split.

Be.label: Be18.1.1
Be.text: Touch-only: pilot opens the Tracking Distance field, taps to reveal an on-screen keypad for direct value entry, or uses on-screen +/- steppers for incremental adjustment; on-screen commit sends. Full task in Touch alone.

Be.label: Be18.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: pilot enters the distance value via UCP alphanumeric keypad, or steps it with the bezel rotary; bezel OSS commits. Full task in Keyboard alone.

Be.label: Be19.1.1
Be.text: Touch-only: from the UAV context (glyph/map or detail panel), press-hold on the UAV surfaces an option ring with a HANDOVER segment; tapping it dispatches the control-handover request.

Be.label: Be19.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard-only: a dedicated HANDOVER button on the bezel OSS, with the UAV pre-selected via rotary/UCP, dispatches the control-handover request on a single press.

Be.label: Be19.1.3
Be.text: Mixed: the UAV Detail/Status Panel (R12 chassis) exposes a HANDOVER row reachable by touch tap or bezel OSS confirm, dispatching the control-handover request.

Be.label: Be20.1.1
Be.text: Touch: one-shot HANDOVER-EXECUTE commit affordance, armed only after R19 acknowledgment, surfaced on the three shared surfaces (dedicated command button, option-ring segment, UAV detail-panel row). Single tap commits the handover, breaks connection, triggers completion notification. Modality-complete.

Be.label: Be20.1.2
Be.text: Keyboard: same armed HANDOVER-EXECUTE commit via bezel OSS / UCP discrete press; one-shot, confirmation-gated (armed only after R19 ack). Modality-complete.

S.label: S01.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot Setpoint Panel (WAD overlay, shared home).

S.label: S01.1.1.2
S.text: Numeric keypad (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.3
S.text: Step controls (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.4
S.text: Preset list (Touch).

S.label: S01.1.1.5
S.text: Bezel rotary+OSS (Keyboard).

S.label: S01.1.1.6
S.text: UCP alphanumeric (Keyboard).

S.label: S02.1.1.1
S.text: AP Target/Current panel (WAD) — shared with AP-set (1.2.3) and AP-mode/state display.

S.label: S02.1.1.2
S.text: AP audio callout (Audio system) — shared notify channel across other requirements.

S.label: S02.1.1.3
S.text: AP 'condition reached' flag (HUD) — dedicated boolean indication, minimal footprint.

S.label: S03.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot Mode Panel (WAD): each autopilot mode a directly-tappable on-screen button, one tap engages that mode (Touch path); panel renders active-mode state (shared with R02).

S.label: S03.1.1.2
S.text: Bezel mode OSS: one dedicated on-screen-select switch per autopilot mode, one press engages that mode directly (Keyboard path).

S.label: S04.1.1.1
S.text: Autopilot mode panel (WAD), shared w/ R03; active-mode controls support re-tap-to-deselect. Touch / Be-04.2.

S.label: S04.1.1.2
S.text: Bezel mode buttons (OSS), shared w/ R03; active-mode OSS re-press-to-deselect + dedicated MANUAL button. Keyboard / both Behaviours.

S.label: S04.2.1.1
S.text: Dedicated MANUAL touch button (WAD) on the mode panel, counterpart to bezel MANUAL. Touch / Be-04.1.

S.label: S05.1.1.1
S.text: Map view (WAD) — existing screen, reused as host surface for press-and-hold interaction and marker rendering. Shared with R06/R07 (map-anchored tasks).

S.label: S05.1.1.2
S.text: Option ring — radial menu overlay spawned at the selected map point, listing preset intelligence markers. Shared mechanic pattern with R06/R07; preset content differs per requirement.

S.label: S05.1.1.3
S.text: Preset marker buttons — selectable intel-taxonomy entries within the option ring (e.g. hostile contact, vehicle, structure).

S.label: S05.1.1.4
S.text: Marker glyph layer — WAD overlay rendering committed markers at their map coordinates.

S.label: S05.1.1.5
S.text: Input bindings (redundant): Touch — press-and-hold on WAD + tap to select/commit; Keyboard — bezel rotary to position/step through presets + OSS to open menu/confirm.

S.label: S06.2.1
S.text: Order Content Panel(WAD, Screen): persistent templated full-order display; stacked overlay layer on the R05 Map/task surface. Always-complete Screen path.

S.label: S06.2.2
S.text: Order TTS readout (cockpit audio, Audio-out): templated full-order speech on arrival; reuses R02 shared notify/audio-out channel. Always-complete Audio path.

S.label: S06.2.3
S.text: HUD order flag (HUD, Screen): minimal eyes-out 'new order' indicator pointing to the WAD panel; supplementary, consistent with R02's dedicated HUD flag.

S.label: S07.2.1.1
S.text: Map view (WAD) - shared, reused from R05/R06.

S.label: S07.2.1.2
S.text: Option ring (radial menu overlay at selected point) - shared widget, reused from R05.

S.label: S07.2.1.3
S.text: Preset marker buttons - shared widget; surveillance event taxonomy as R07-specific content.

S.label: S07.2.1.4
S.text: Marker glyph layer (committed event markers on map) - shared layer, reused from R05.

S.label: S07.2.1.5
S.text: Input bindings: Touch (hold+tap) / Keyboard (bezel rotary + OSS) - shared binding pattern, both modality-complete.

S.label: S08.1.3.1
S.text: Confirmation audio cue: one dedicated fixed tone on the Audio system, identical for all transactional acknowledgements (learnable as 'command confirmed'). Shares the notify channel with R02, distinct tone ID. Serves Be-08.1.3.

S.label: S08.2.3.1
S.text: New-message audio cue: distinct tone on the Audio system, different from the ack cue (learnable as 'new message'). Shares the notify channel with R02, distinct tone ID. Serves Be-08.2.3.

S.label: S08.3.3.1
S.text: State-change audio cue: distinct tone on the Audio system, different from ack and new-message cues (learnable as 'state changed'). Shares the notify channel and pattern with R02, distinct tone ID. Serves Be-08.3.3.

S.label: S08.0.0.2
S.text: Pop-up component on the WAD screen with three configurable modes: transient (auto-decays after 5 s, no dismiss) for acks (Be-08.1.3); preview (shows first words of an incoming message, opens full in Messages tab) for orders/responses (Be-08.2.3); on-demand (opens from a directed marker, shows the details of what changed) for capability-state changes (Be-08.3.3).

S.label: S08.0.0.3
S.text: Notification marker component on the WAD screen with two configurable modes: generic unread badge/count anchored on the Messages tab (Be-08.2.3); directed marker anchored to the specific screen/panel that changed (Be-08.3.3). Selectable via Touch (WAD) or bezel OSS (Keyboard) to retrieve the associated pop-up.

S.label: S08.2.3.4
S.text: Messages tab/screen on the WAD: persistent message list with unread markers and timestamps, retained until acknowledged. Extends the R06 order-output panel rather than duplicating it. Serves Be-08.2.3.

S.label: S09.1.1.1
S.text: UAV glyph layer on Map view (new, shared across R10–R15) with tap-to-select highlight; dedicated REQUEST TAKEOVER button (unified logical control, this invocation surface); R08 request-pending notification-marker on selected glyph. Touch: tap glyph then tap REQUEST. Keyboard: bezel OSS steps glyph focus then dedicated REQUEST OSS commits; UCP UAV-ID entry as alternate selection.

S.label: S09.1.2.1
S.text: UAV glyph layer (shared); reused R05/R07 option ring widget with new Takeover segment (unified REQUEST TAKEOVER control, this invocation surface); R08 request-pending notification-marker. Touch: press-hold glyph then ring then Takeover then commit. Keyboard: OSS focus then OSS open ring then rotary step to Takeover then OSS commit.

S.label: S09.1.3.1
S.text: New WAD UAV Detail/Status Panel (strong shared candidate for R05 UAV-status, R06 ISR feed, R07 tracking, R08 handover status-hide) opened for selected UAV; in-panel TAKEOVER button (unified REQUEST TAKEOVER control, this invocation surface); R08 request-pending marker in panel header. Touch: open panel then tap TAKEOVER. Keyboard: bezel OSS opens panel for focused UAV then OSS commits Takeover; UCP UAV-ID to open.

S.label: S10.1.1.1
S.text: Dedicated COMMAND TAKEOVER button co-located with the R08 confirmation delivery (pop-up / messages-tab entry). Touch: single tap on WAD button. Keyboard: mapped bezel OSS press. Rendered inert/greyed until R08 delivers the request-acknowledged state, then enabled; reverts after commit or on timeout/link-loss. Fastest, lowest-workload commit with no navigation. Modality-complete (Touch or Keyboard alone completes the commit). Reused/extended from R09.

S.label: S10.1.1.2
S.text: Option-ring segment: the R09 press-and-hold radial option ring invoked on a UAV glyph (Map or UAV list), extended with a COMMAND TAKEOVER segment. Touch: press-and-hold on UAV -> ring opens -> select segment -> release to commit. Keyboard: bezel rotary rotates segment selection + OSS confirm. Segment enabled/visible only post-ack for that UAV. Spatial/in-context commit from the UAV's position without opening a full panel. Modality-complete. Reused/extended from R09.

S.label: S10.1.1.3
S.text: UAV detail panel row: a COMMAND TAKEOVER row within the selected-UAV detail panel. Touch: tap the row. Keyboard: bezel rotary steps focus to the row + OSS press to activate. Row disabled until ack for that specific UAV, then enabled. Context-explicit commit bound to an open, identified UAV, guarding against commanding the wrong UAV. Modality-complete. Reused/extended from R09.

S.label: S11.1.1.1
S.text: UAV Parameter Panel (WAD): three parameter rows (speed/altitude/heading), each with numeric field + keypad (Touch, direct entry) and ± steppers (Touch, step adjust), plus a preset profile selector row (Touch); bezel rotary maps to selected-row stepping and UCP alphanumeric for direct value entry (Keyboard path); commit/Send affordance via Touch OSS and bezel OSS. Both modalities complete. R01 Setpoint-Panel component family re-instantiated with UAV parameter semantics.

S.label: S11.2.1.1
S.text: Acknowledgment via shared R08 notification stack: audio tone (shared Audio notify channel) plus reusable multi-mode pop-up, notification marker, and messages-tab entry, with the parameter-accepted event routed into existing R08 notification components. No new structure; entirely R08-shared.

S.label: S12.1.1.1
S.text: Reused WAD UAV Detail/Status Panel (shared with R10/R11), with a persistent UAV Status tab/OSS to toggle show/hide and a header close (X) control; panel body renders attitude/health/state. Modality-complete: Touch (tab / X) or Keyboard (bezel toggle OSS / dismiss OSS); Screen renders the panel.

S.label: S13.1.1.1
S.text: Extended R12 UAV Detail/Status Panel on WAD rendering the live UAV status field set (link, mode, health, fuel, position/attitude summary), updating in place. Shared structure with R12 (visibility toggle) and R08 (notifications).

S.label: S13.1.1.2
S.text: HUD abbreviated always-on status strip showing link, mode and a health rollup for head-up glance; reduced field set complementing the WAD panel.

S.label: S13.2.x.1
S.text: R08 notification stack, severity-parameterized: audio tone channel with distinct tones per severity tier (advisory/caution/warning) or a single tone for the flat case, plus field-level highlight/flag on the status panel (colour-coded by severity) and reusable pop-up/notification-marker for higher tiers. Covers Be-13.2.1 (flat) and Be-13.2.2 (graded). No new hardware.

S.label: S13.2.x.2
S.text: HUD-escalated warning: for warning-tier events (e.g. link loss), the alert flag is pushed to the HUD status strip (S-13.1.1.2) so it is caught head-up, not only on WAD. Escalation layer tied into R08.

S.label: S14.1.1.1
S.text: Map-anchored designation set (serves Be-14.1.1): Map view + live-feed frame as tappable press-and-hold surfaces (WAD); option ring overlay reused from R05/R07 with a 'Move Sensor Here / POI / AOI' segment; sensor-aimpoint glyph layer showing commanded aimpoint and current sensor footprint; slew-complete acknowledgement via shared R08 notification stack. Shared elements: option ring, marker/glyph layer, R08 ack (reused across R05/R07/R14).

S.label: S14.1.2.2
S.text: HMD designate-and-slew set (serves Be-14.1.2 and Be-14.1.3): HMD visor reticle showing gaze/head aimpoint over forward view and feed footprint; head/eye-tracking input driving discrete designation and continuous head-slew; HOTAS engage/confirm button or UCP key committing discrete designation and holding engage for continuous steering; sensor-aimpoint glyph mirrored on WAD and HUD strip for cross-check. Shared elements: aimpoint glyph layer (with S-14.1.1.1); HUD strip reused from R13.

S.label: S14.1.4.3
S.text: Continuous rate-slew set (serves Be-14.1.4): TDC for rate-based aim deflection, hands-on-throttle (primary); WAD swipe zone on the feed frame as the touch-surface drag-to-rate-slew alternative; rate/direction indicator overlay showing current slew vector with live-moving footprint; shared sensor-aimpoint glyph layer. Shared elements: glyph layer; TDC also usable as cursor for placing the Be-14.1.1 press-hold point.

S.label: S15.1.1.1
S.text: Map-anchored geometry editor (serves Be-15.1.1/.1.2/.1.3): Search-Area overlay layer on the shared Map view with draggable vertex/rotate handles (Touch path); two-way-bound Geometry Field strip via UCP alphanumeric + bezel rotary (Keyboard path); binding between them serves the Mixed path; commit via OSS + on-panel button. Reuses Map view and overlay/commit pattern from R05/R14.

S.label: S15.2.1.1
S.text: Re-instantiated Setpoint Panel (serves Be-15.2.1/.2.2/.2.3), shared reuse from R01/R11, with search-pattern attribute set (leg spacing, orientation, scan speed, overlap %): keypad/steppers/presets (Touch path); bezel rotary + UCP (Keyboard path); field-by-field mix (Mixed path); acknowledgment via shared R08 notification stack.

S.label: S16.1.1.1
S.text: ISR Feed Panel/Window on the WAD (stacked overlay layer up to the 8-source limit, reusing the R12/R13 Detail/Status Panel chassis with header, close X, and persistent toggle) rendering the ISR sensor stream, invoked via an 'ISR FEED' button on the UAV screen (Touch) and via a bezel OSS / UCP soft-key toggle (Keyboard), with a WAD panel header X / re-summon control (Touch).

S.label: S16.2.1.1
S.text: In-panel source selector inside the ISR Feed Panel: a source tab strip/list with one entry per sensor source (EO/IR/radar/...) and active source highlighted (Touch), plus a detented bezel rotary or UCP up/down keys that step the active source with the selection reflected on the same tab strip (Keyboard).

S.label: S17.1.1.1
S.text: Map/ISR-anchored designation surface: Map view + R16 ISR Feed Panel as target-selection canvas, reused track/contact glyph layer (tappable target symbols, selected TOI highlights), press-hold to option-ring designation pattern (R05/R14) for marker drop on empty space, bezel rotary to step through track list with bezel OSS to confirm selection, UCP alphanumeric for track-ID/coordinate entry, TDC cursor pointing on WAD. Serves Be-17.1.1 (Touch) and Be-17.1.2 (Keyboard).

S.label: S17.2.1.1
S.text: Tracking commit controls: option-ring TRACK segment (Touch, appears on active TOI, reuses R14 ring), dedicated bezel TRACK OSS (Keyboard commit), and TOI detail/status row with inline TRACK affordance (reuses R12/R13 Detail Panel chassis). Net-new element for R17. Serves Be-17.2.1 (Touch), Be-17.2.2 (Keyboard), and Be-17.2.3 (Mixed).

S.label: S18.1.1.3
S.text: Setpoint Panel re-instantiated for a single 'Tracking Distance' field, using the same interaction grammar as the AP Parameters panel (R01/R11): Touch keypad + on-screen +/- steppers (Be-18.1.1); Keyboard bezel rotary + UCP alphanumeric (Be-18.1.2); commit via on-screen button or bezel OSS; ack via shared R08 notification stack. Plus an inline editable distance row embedded in the R17 tracking panel as a co-located quick-access surface.

S.label: S19.1.1.1
S.text: Dedicated HANDOVER button — bezel OSS (Keyboard) plus WAD touch affordance (Touch), shared chassis with R09 takeover button; dispatches the control-handover request for the selected UAV.

S.label: S19.1.2.1
S.text: HANDOVER segment on the shared press-hold option ring anchored to the UAV glyph (Map/detail), reusing the R05/R09/R14/R17 ring pattern; dispatches the handover request.

S.label: S19.1.3.1
S.text: HANDOVER row in the reused UAV Detail/Status Panel (R12 chassis), actionable via Touch tap or bezel OSS confirm; dispatches the handover request. Response/ack surfaces through the R08 notification stack.

S.label: S20.1.1.1
S.text: Reused three-surface commit set with HANDOVER-EXECUTE binding: dedicated command button (WAD, shared R09/R10/R19) with armed HANDOVER-EXECUTE state; option-ring segment (shared press-hold ring) with HANDOVER-EXECUTE segment; UAV detail-panel row (shared R12/R13/R16 chassis) with HANDOVER-EXECUTE row; bezel OSS + UCP (Keyboard) mapped to the same armed action. Arming driven by R19-ack state; completion and status-hide via reused R08 notification stack + R12/R13 panel (8.1.16-8.1.18). One-shot confirmation-gated commit atop R19's request binding.
